floors.reason: household env on five more functions (SEC-13a) and per-person critter scope: v5.3.22 sets GARDEN_HOUSEHOLD_IDS on critter, achievements, app-events, favorites and ux-events and moves critter to per-person scope. The deploy step only adds or keeps that key and never removes it, so a code revert below v5.3.22 runs the old critter code (householdScope) with the key set and merges Dave's and Jen's critter state (its bulk viewed_at update marks both stickerbooks viewed). Undo order: remove GARDEN_HOUSEHOLD_IDS from those five functions first (scripts/lambda-env-set.sh, on Dave's yes), then forward-fix. Forward-fix only.

multi-space 3.2c (migrations/v5-wxwriterplot-001): once garden_wx_writer holds INSERT on weather_cold_range.plot_id and the off-repo cold-range job (project-state/tools/wn3_send.py) names plot_id from its config, only code at or above v5.3.14 carries the 1a-writer-role.sql (its W3b) and scripts/wx-writer-role.py that keep that grant: older code's 1a, re-run after a restore or by wx-writer-role.py apply, converges on seven columns and the job is refused (42501) every night, the cold-range card blank. The job is not in this repo, so a code revert never switches it back. Forward-fix only.

multi-space 3.2b then 3.2d (migrations/v5-wxplotnotnull-001): once weather_daily.plot_id is NOT NULL every writer must stamp it, and code below v5.3.13 stamps none (lambda/daily-plan/handler.js writeWeatherDaily and scripts/backfill-weather-daily.mjs began to in v5.3.13), so every weather_daily row it writes is refused 23502, logged as a skipped row, and the plan's weather goes stale. In force from v5.3.14, the release that carries the NOT NULL file. Forward-fix only.

multi-space Phase 1 migration dirs (v5-spaceguard-001 and after): once 0a is applied, spaces, weather_daily and weather_cold_range carry delete/truncate/re-point guards, and only code at or above v5.2.2 tears integration fixtures down in the order they allow (tests/integration/_cleanup.js NS_SPACES deletes a fixture Space's weather and theme rows first and probes their residue; season-stats deletes its own weather rows). Older code puts back the cleanup the guard refuses, so fixture Spaces leak on every CI fork with the failure logged and the probes gone. Forward-fix only.

seed release 3 (put more seed in a seed lot already started): once this ships, prod holds rows in seed_lot_addition, lots whose count was raised by a picking, and seed_saved timeline entries marked addition. Code at or above v4.170.0 reads every row this release leaves, never names seed_lot_addition, never hard-deletes a link row, and its merge moves link rows so pickings follow. Undo release 3 by switching SEED_ADD_TO_LOT off (rehearsal: npm run test:flag-off:seedadd); the table stays. The count-save guard (three expected_seed_* keys on the measure PUT) is not behind the flag: undoing it is a code revert of 74c2f805, a1d6f660 and b79fe5ff.

seed release 2b (the Save seed flow for several plantings): once this ships, prod holds jars with two or more parent rows in seed_lot_parent_planting and jars filed under a household mix variety. Code below v4.170.0 writes inventory_items.source_plant_id alone and cannot see link rows, so it would show and rewrite such a jar as a one-parent jar. Undo release 2b by switching SEED_MULTI_PARENT off (the flag-off build is green as it stands; rehearsal: npm run test:flag-off:seed) BEFORE any undo of release 2a (v4.171.0).

Put-Up B′ schema and writers (v5-pantry-001, v5-batchbuilder-001, v5-recipes-001): once prod holds pantry items, pantry lines, recipes or recipe-linked batches, older code over that data misreads it — v4.164.0 has no route for /api/pantry or /api/recipes, drops pantry lines from What went in and the planting reads, ignores kitchen_batch.recipe_id and the recipe discard basis, and its put-up Remove hard-ignores the jar_was_used / jar_in_batch refusals. Forward-fix only (05-release-train §4).

put-up + ferment schema and writers (v5-putupmake-001, v5-fermentpath-001): older code over this data refuses nothing it should — the legacy PUT has no delta_at refusal and silently overwrites counts that ferment draws moved, getBatch returns taken-out lines, a hard DELETE of a drawn line 23503s on pantry_use, cached 4.164.0 bundles' PATCH /api/preservation/:id and POST /api/pantry/uses hit no route, and after 0p a 1a date edit raises 23514. Forward-fix only.

plant-reduction event tokens renamed (failed -> reduction_lost, given_away -> reduction_given_away): once prod writes or backfills the new tokens, older code does not treat those rows as reductions, so deleting one would not restore its planting's count and the edit guard would let it be re-typed with its counters applied

page-scroll manager: history.scrollRestoration is 'manual' per history entry and only a bundle that knows SCROLL_MANAGER_ENABLED writes 'auto' back, so an older bundle leaves open sessions losing their place on Back until the app is closed

daily-plan schedule: garden-daily-plan-hourly is live and the nightly, intraday-am and intraday-pm rules are retired; deploy-lambda.yml before v4.135.0 re-creates the nightly rule (v4.134.0) or all three (v4.129.0 and earlier) and never deletes the hourly one, so the plan would run on two schedules
